Despite being under Republican control, the House just defied President Trump on the Iran war.

No amount of lying or bullying by the White House can make Americans forget we're paying for a senseless war.

Now even some GOP Members of Congress are recognizing they ultimately answer to us - not him. 

Keep up the pressure.

posts.text: The Supreme Court has rolled back decades of hard-won civil rights progress. This decision will make Congress less representative for millions of Black Americans and others, and allow more politicians to pick their voters rather than the other way around. But this isn’t a moment to give in to despair - now is the time to take action and build something better: a truly representative democracy, capable of improving everyday life.
